'''Ackawi cheese triangles''' make use of a specialty cheese called ackawi.

==Ingredients==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (8 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] / 225 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) shredded Wisconsin [[Cookbook:Ackawi|Ackawi]] cheese
* ½ cup (120 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] fresh [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]]
* ¼ cup (60 ml) chopped [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Egg White|egg white]], slightly beaten 
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] (1.25 ml) [[Cookbook:Chili Powder|ground red pepper]]
* 2 sheets frozen [[Cookbook:Puff pastry|puff pastry]],

==Procedure==

# Combine cheese, parsley, onion, egg white, and red pepper; set aside.
# On a lightly floured surface, [[Cookbook:Dough#Rolling|roll]] 1 sheet pastry into a 12 x 12-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (30 x 30 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) square; cut into 16 ea. 3 x 3-inch (7.5 x 7.5 cm) squares.
# Place 1 tablespoon (15 ml) cheese mixture on each square; fold pastry over each filling, forming a triangle. Seal edges with tines of a fork; place on an ungreased [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]].
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at 400°F (200°C) for 10 minutes or until golden brown. Repeat process with second sheet of puff pastry.
# Serve warm.
